column1: # M11-complexity-T2 (D-0141). The differential lane's CONFIGURATIONS, one per line.
# THIS IS THE ONE FILE TO EXTEND when a flag merges (the restart and activity flags of
# wave45-strategy are the slots below). A new line needs its reference recorded once,
# with `scripts/diff_lane.sh --update --config NAME` on the binary that introduced it,
# in the same merge -- a configuration without a reference FAILS, it is never skipped.
# Columns, TAB-separated:
#   name    a short word, used as the reference directory name
#   env     space-separated VAR=value pairs put in the solver's environment, or -
#   flags   extra command-line flags, or -
#   proof   yes: --proof is passed and the .opb/.pbp hashes are compared
#           no:  the flags must say how the run goes without one (--no-proof)
# The node budget is per INSTANCE (corpus.tsv), never per configuration.
# BAGUETTE_NODE_LIMIT is set by the runner; do not set it here.
default
noproof
lbd
fifo
nopb
bits0

# restarts
# activity
